About Dr. Ksenia Pillai

Dr. Ksenia Pillai is a distinguished psychiatrist specializing in child, adult, and reproductive psychiatry. With extensive experience in mental health care across different life stages, she is dedicated to providing personalized and functional treatment tailored to each patient's unique needs. She earned her medical degree and completed her general psychiatry residency at Jamaica Hospital Medical Center, where she developed a deep understanding of the complexities of the human mind. Driven by a passion for expanding her expertise, she pursued specialized training in child psychiatry at SUNY Downstate. In addition, Dr. Pillai has extensive experience in reproductive psychiatry, helping individuals navigate the psychological challenges associated with pregnancy, postpartum mental health, and hormonal transitions.

Areas of Expertise

General Psychiatry Child Psychiatry Reproductive & Perinatal Psychiatry Postpartum Mental Health Hormonal Mood Disorders (PMDD) Women's Mental Health Anxiety & Depression Trauma & PTSD Pregnancy Loss Support Menopause-Related Psychiatry Parent-Infant Bonding Chronic Illness Support

Clinical Philosophy

Dr. Ksenia Pillai believes that every patient deserves care that honors their full story — not just their diagnosis. She takes a functional and personalized approach, working closely with patients to understand the biological, psychological, and life-stage factors shaping their mental health. Her work in reproductive psychiatry reflects a deep commitment to supporting patients through some of the most vulnerable transitions in life.

Session Format

Initial Consultation (40 minutes): A thorough assessment of your history, current symptoms, and goals. May extend to 1–2 sessions depending on history, records review, and your preference. You will leave with a clear clinical impression and proposed treatment pathway.

Follow-up / Medication Management (20 minutes): Regular review appointments to monitor progress, adjust treatment, and ensure your care remains responsive. Follow-up sessions available in 20-minute increments.

In-person & Telehealth: All appointment types are available both in-person at our clinic locations and via HIPAA-compliant secure video consultation.

After-Hours Crisis Appointments: Available at 1.5× standard fee for urgent situations.

Ready to book with Pillai?

In-person appointments available in Reston VA, Oakland CA, and Honolulu HI. Telehealth available nationwide.
